description:
Wern-Wood is one of South Wales's leading timber, fencing, decking and agricultural supply merchants. Based in Briton Ferry, Neath, we supply tradespeople, landscapers and homeowners across the region with quality treated timber and outdoor supplies at prices that beat the nationals.

Our affiliate programme pays 3% commission on every qualifying sale you refer, tracked over a 30-day cookie window. There are no complicated tiers or targets — share your unique link or discount code with your audience and earn every time someone buys. Payouts are monthly with a £20 minimum threshold.

We're a natural fit for content creators, tradespeople and anyone with an audience interested in home improvement, landscaping, fencing, decking or outdoor living. If your audience builds, landscapes or works outdoors, we'd love to work with you.

Wern-Wood Affiliate Programme — Terms & Conditions

Last updated: June 2026

1. About the Programme

The Wern-Wood Affiliate Programme allows approved participants to earn commission by referring customers to wern-wood.co.uk. By applying to or participating in the programme, you agree to these terms in full.

2. Eligibility & Approval

Participation is by application only. Wern-Wood reserves the right to approve or decline any application at its sole discretion, and to terminate any affiliate relationship at any time. You must be 18 or over and based in the United Kingdom to participate.

3. Commission

Approved affiliates earn 3% commission on qualifying orders placed by referred customers. A qualifying order is a completed, paid order placed within 30 days of a customer first clicking your unique affiliate link, where the order has not been subsequently cancelled or refunded. Commission is calculated on the net order value, excluding VAT, delivery charges, and any discounts applied at checkout.

4. Cookie Window

Referrals are tracked via a 30-day cookie. If a customer clicks your link and purchases within 30 days, the sale is attributed to you. If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent click takes precedence.

5. Payouts

Commission is paid via PayPal. A minimum balance of £20 must be accumulated before a payout is issued. Payouts are processed monthly. You are responsible for ensuring your PayPal details are accurate. Wern-Wood accepts no liability for failed payments resulting from incorrect information provided by the affiliate.

6. Prohibited Conduct

Affiliates must not:

  • Bid on Wern-Wood branded keywords in paid search campaigns
  • Use misleading, false, or deceptive promotional content
  • Offer unauthorised discounts, cashback, or incentives
  • Self-refer or refer immediate family members
  • Spam or use unsolicited email marketing to promote the programme
  • Misrepresent their relationship with Wern-Wood

7. Disclosure

Affiliates must clearly disclose their participation in the programme wherever affiliate links are shared, in compliance with ASA and CAP guidelines. Use of #ad or #affiliate is required on social media posts.

8. Intellectual Property

Wern-Wood grants affiliates a limited, non-exclusive licence to use approved brand assets (logos, images, copy) for the purpose of promoting the programme. Affiliates must not alter, distort, or misuse brand assets.

9. Liability

Wern-Wood is not responsible for the content, accuracy, or legality of any affiliate's promotional activity. Affiliates promote Wern-Wood products at their own risk and are solely responsible for any claims arising from their promotional content. Wern-Wood does not endorse or accept responsibility for any project, installation, or workmanship a customer undertakes using products purchased through an affiliate referral.

10. Amendments & Termination

Wern-Wood reserves the right to amend these terms at any time. Continued participation following notice of changes constitutes acceptance. Wern-Wood may suspend or terminate an affiliate's account at any time, with or without cause. Any unpaid commission earned prior to termination will be paid at the next scheduled payout, provided it meets the minimum threshold.

11. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales.
